description: This file defines structures, classes, and functions for benchmarking throughput of PyTorch modules, including configuration, execution statistics, and helper classes for running benchmarks, primarily used for performance testing and profiling.

classes.name: BenchmarkHelper
classes.description: A helper class to abstract out different models for throughput testing, supporting running and adding inputs, and benchmarking with configuration.

classes.name: ModuleInput
classes.description: Represents input data for a module, supporting move semantics and initialization with pybind args and kwargs.

classes.name: ThroughputBenchmark
classes.description: Main class for executing throughput benchmarks on PyTorch modules, supporting multi-threaded execution and input management.

methods.name: BenchmarkHelper
methods.description: Constructor for BenchmarkHelper, with specialization for different models.

methods.name: runOnce
methods.description: Runs the benchmark once with given input.

methods.name: addInput
methods.description: Adds input data to the benchmark helper.

methods.name: benchmark
methods.description: Performs the benchmark with specified configuration and returns statistics.

methods.name: runOnce
methods.description: Runs the module once with specified arguments.

methods.name: benchmark
methods.description: Runs the throughput benchmark and returns execution statistics.
